Full release notes: **https://danbyte.net/news/v0-16-0**

### New in 0.16.5

#### Fixed

- **3D room: cables on a second stack member land on their ports.** A device type whose photo markers are named with `{position}` (`TenGigabitEthernet{position}/0/1`) resolved correctly on the faceplate and in the face-ports lookup, but the room's cable trace rendered marker names without the device's stack position, so member 2's cables anchored on the middle of the face. The scene payload now carries each device's stack position and the trace uses it.

#### Added

- **An address can carry its own mask length.** A `/31` point-to-point link inside a `/24` link block no longer needs a `/31` prefix of its own just to render the right mask. The IP address form has a **Mask length** field, the API accepts `10.50.10.1/31` on write and returns `mask_length` and the effective `cidr`, and the export-template filters, the routing context and the Ansible inventory all use the address's own length when set, else the prefix's. The list marks such addresses with their `/31`.
